sections.name: body
sections.value: Security for #331 at 0a8490f: pass. Static review in a detached worktree; CI 5/5. (1) No SQL injection: LIST_LIVE_OR_OWED_SQL is a const &str with no format! or string building. The two kind prefixes are bound parameters (?1, ?2) from the single-source constants DELIVERY_KIND_PREFIX and CONTROL_KIND_PREFIX, and the states are literals. No caller input reaches the query. INDEXED BY names fixed indexes, and a missing index makes SQLite refuse loudly rather than return a different answer. (2) No secrets in logs: the new auth_recovery line prints the seat id plus the lease-read error (a delivery or registry read error, the same class the first lease read already logs). It has no body, token, env or payload, and it still spares (fail-closed, a BRAKE that records nothing). (3) No permission or role change: list_live_or_owed is a read used only by drain_once, and it returns rows the old full scan already returned, a subset narrowed to live plus owed. It grants nothing and changes no route, holder or authority. The PA watchdog stays on the full scan, and fakes return a superset. No secrets, lockfile or .npmrc changes.
